CLOSED. Both halves landed and proven. Half 1 (sync): deploy job checks out the repo, digests docker-compose.yml, ships it to the host via temp-file + digest-verified atomic swap, refusing on an empty payload or a shadow file. Half 2 (verify): the guard recomputes the host spec digest after up -d and fails loud on a mismatch, so green now means the DEPLOYMENT SPEC is current, not only the image. Commits 890f25b (workflow) + 6f58f76 (compose comment). Discrimination proven on apps with the shipped blocks: diverged spec rc=1 naming both digests; shadow compose.yaml rc=1; matching spec rc=0; sync repairs a diverged spec rc=0; empty payload rc=1 with the live spec NOT truncated; live spec byte-identical before and after (7f408ef7...). End to end: run 36165963944, compose-only change, build-push AND deploy success, log shows 'deploy spec: CHANGED 7f408ef7... -> 5ed5c7d4...' then 'deploy guard: OK' then 'deploy spec: verified (5ed5c7d4...)'; host spec == repo digest; no shadow file; container healthy, public /health 200.
